Holland Inc., Chicago, Illinois); Paul Kantor Gallery, Beverly Hills, California, 1961; The Downtown Gallery, New York, NY, 1961; Private collection, Providence, Rhode Island, 1968; The Downtown Gallery, New York, NY, 1968; Estate of Edith G. Halpert, 1970; Sotheby Parke Bernet Inc., New York, NY, sale no. 3483, lot no. 55, 15 March 1973; (ACA Galleries, New York, NY) (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks. Photocopy in Downtown Gallery Archive of exhibition label indicates "Georgia O'Keeffe at 'An American Place'/509 Madison Ave. – Room 1710/(S.E. Corner 53rd Str – New York, N.Y.)/'Wave' – (1923) Pastel/by Georgia O'Keeffe/44 Selected paintings/(1915–1927) January 29–March 17/34" (Alfred Stieglitz, black ink). Downtown Gallery Archive dates 1923. Dated 1922 on basis of inclusion in 1923 New York (Anderson) exhibition, pictured in Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 13. Orientation based on installation photograph. See cat. nos. 381–83, 385–87. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
